finalists.label: Fibrolipomatous hamartoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including fibroadipose tissue and vascular proliferation, thickened and fragmented collagen bundles, subcutaneous-based proliferation of spindle cells with varying density, and mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue.

finalists.label: Lipomatosis
finalists.why: It has specific findings, including subcutaneous-based proliferation of spindle cells with varying density and mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue, with no evidence against it.

finalists.label: Madelung disease
finalists.why: It has specific and decisive clinical findings, including progressive skin thickening and subcutaneous enlargement, enlargement of soft tissue with thickening of the overlying skin, and slightly hyperplastic soft tissue with dilated patulous follicles.

frontier_selector.why: Fibrolipomatous hamartoma is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive histopathological findings, including fibroadipose tissue, vascular proliferation, and thickened collagen bundles, which are not explained by Madelung disease.
